description: D³-Dataset: A Multi-Temporal Fine-Grained Damage Assessment Dataset for Critical Infrastructure D³-Dataset: A Multi-Temporal Fine-Grained Damage Assessment Dataset for Critical Infrastructure is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors 张伊丹, 王天琦 (University of Chinese Academy of Sciences). The D³-Dataset is developed for multi-temporal fine-grained damage assessment of critical infrastructure, covering airports, ports, and industrial facilities affected by different disaster events. It provides object-level annotations for 15 infrastructure categories with four damage levels: intact, minor damage, major damage, and destroyed. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 5392018 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
